newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta's share index drops, turnover up.
newsitem.headline: Malta's share index drops, turnover up.

text.p: Malta's share index dropped 3.13 points at the once weekly trading session of the Malta Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
Turnover reached 2.4 million Malta pounds, up from 1.8 million pounds the week before.
The biggest loser in the equities market was Lombard Bank (Malta) where 4,000 shares were traded in seven deals at an average 161.8 cents each, down 1.2 cents.
Bank of Valletta shares lost 1.1 cents, with 20,648 shares selling for an average of 147.2 cents.
There was no change in the price of Middle Sea Insurance shares, where 190 shares traded in two deals for 123 cents each.
Simonds Farsons Cisk ordinary dropped one cent, with 987 shares selling for an average 48 cents each, but Suncrest Hotels shares were up seven mils, with 200 shares selling for 73 cents each.
In government bonds, there were 63 deals in 18 securities with a value of 2.3 million pounds.
In corporate bonds, there was one deal in 7.25 percent Mid- Med Bank unsecured loan stock 2005 at a value of 1,200 pounds.
The share index closed at 1092.18 points
